messages:
Aisha (CSM): Heads-up — Silverstrand just flagged a billing surprise in procurement call; they say invoices jumped after the 2/1 upgrade. Low usage since Friday. Can we triage?
Devon (Sales Eng): Saw that — their account shows a single big spike then steady drop. Procurement is now evaluating WhisperTech. :grimacing:
Olivia (Customer Success): Confirming — main advocate (Samir) left last week. New PM hasn't been looped. I talked to them this AM, they're worried about cost + latency regressions with the new model variant.
Riley (Finance): Deploy bot reported an overage charge on 2024-11-30 invoice: ```Invoice 20241130 Delta: +43% token spend due to model:rw-v2-alpha```
deploy-bot: Invoice 20241130 generated for acct:silverstrand — total: $12,403. Alert level: billing-anomaly
Aisha (CSM): Proposed immediate steps: 1) temporary credit for the delta 2) emergency technical deep-dive with Eng runtime 3) schedule a joint call w/ procurement + new PM. Thoughts?
Devon (Sales Eng): Can do deep-dive — I'll bring logs and KV cache stats. Might be a batching misconfig after upgrade. Tentative slot today 4pm PT.
Olivia (Customer Success): I'll prep a short usage rollback playbook and send step-by-step. Also need to capture their eval criteria vs WhisperTech — is it price, latency, or data residency?
Riley (Finance): Credit ok up to $5k on an exception; need approval for more. I'll ping legal to fast-track a one-off amend. :+1:
Devon (Sales Eng): Quick note: logs show concurrent requests increased with longer seq_len. Suspect model variant selection routed them to rw-v2-alpha fallback. We can pin to rw-v1-stable for now.
Aisha (CSM): @Olivia please capture follow-ups: call invite, provisional credit amount, rollback steps, and a success metric to restore confidence. I'll own the exec touchpoint.
Olivia (Customer Success): On it. Draft invite sent. I'll include a short checklist: reproduction steps, timeline, contact list, and a rollback command snippet. ```redwood rollback --acct silverstrand --model rw-v1-stable```
Devon (Sales Eng): I'll prepare perf / token breakdown: per-route qps, prefix hit-rate, KV cache occupancy. Expect ~15 min prep.
Aisha (CSM): Thanks. One more — procurement asked about dedicated discount options. We should surface Dedicated pricing and migration path in the call.
Olivia (Customer Success): Noted. I'll add a slide with Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs and an estimated migration timeline.
Aisha (CSM): Great — we'll aim to close asap. If they still evaluate WhisperTech after cost fix, we pivot to a 30-day A/B with rw-v1-stable vs rw-v2-alpha under our Dedicated credits. :eyes:
Riley (Finance): Logged: provisional credit $5k. If call outcomes require >$5k, escalate to @fin-lead. I'll attach transaction id when processed.
Olivia (Customer Success): Follow-ups saved in the thread. Will update after call. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
